retro:
# Retrospective

## Worked

Read-only pre-execution triage, verified Team 2 context, fresh exact-model reviewer sessions, equivalent neutral scope and saved independent finals. Synthetic device trees directly exercise the production detector without hardware or authentication mutation. Both accepted seals and raw producer results inspected. No artificial findings quota.

## Deviations and exclusions

- Opus ran host pacman -Qi as a read-only package-version probe outside review.py. This violates the runtime-probe routing rule. No PR code, services, hardware or accounts were exercised by that query. Exclude package-support/version assertions from public claims. Coordinator explicitly instructed no recurrence.
- Opus private clone checkout/status omitted GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; only private index metadata was affected. Shared object storage was read, not experimentally written.
- Opus's in-sandbox bash version probe retained only its first line, not complete child streams from launch. It is not needed for the public conclusions.
- Opus fixture records status mismatches but delays failure until its end. copy_exec checks parent, not final destination, and lacks a dangling-symlink refusal. No mismatch or escape occurred in the inspected run; created paths were fresh private directories. Coordinator required these gaps be recorded in a process addendum and reinforced fail-fast/final-target requirements before future work. The independently guarded Sol bundle supports the public detection comparison. Focused-suite outputs remain valid because all prerequisites/results actually succeeded.
- Sol's original synthetic-driver symlinks caused the runner to refuse sealing. Entire unsealed run excluded, preserved in reviewers/astra/experiment. Separate pinned v2 unlinks asserted synthetic links and seals successfully.
- Read-only source lookup errors (coordinator guessed a nonexistent setup filename; Sol initially used the checkout path as a Git directory) executed no PR code. Corrected source reads used actual filenames/repository layout.
- Native agent history remains under approved state session paths, not assignment evidence. No deletion of failed or native history.

## Corrections and stopping condition

Future fixtures must assert final resolved copy destinations, reject existing/dangling targets, fail immediately on unexpected child status, and stream every probe's raw output. Version/package probes are runtime validation even when read-only. Preserve historical fixtures rather than editing sealed inputs. No additional experiments were needed after material detector questions were answered and native hardware boundaries explicitly excluded.

No confirmed Omadev bug or desktop resource use. Reviewer panes remain for coordinator lifecycle handoff; completed isolated runtimes have no persistent services.

| Vendor `3274`, no product descriptor or driver | Not detected | Detected |
| `MAFP General Device` descriptor, unrelated synthetic vendor | Not detected | Detected |

The 15 focused repository checks pass at the PR head. Running the new test file against the baseline detector passes the 11 existing checks, then fails at the first new MAFP case.

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source inspection and synthetic USB files, not physical reader testing. Detection does not establish libfprint support or successful enrollment; setup, PAM changes and authentication were not exercised.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Astra Medium initial inspection, independent Opus 5.5 High and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical reviews, followed by Astra verification of the claims against saved source and test evidence.
